title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a local attacker to cause a denial of… (CVE-2026-108838)
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability that allows a local attacker to cause a denial of service by consuming resources uncontrollably. The issue does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability. The vulnerability has a low severity score and no known exploits in the wild. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
